_doc: From-scratch 1v1 hero (4x128) on the real 2.17.3 rules (main after PR #11), Curio cluster: the hero-1v1 recipe (experiments/hero/hero-1v1.json, Oct 26) with checkpoint_every 20 and send_thread off. Parent = random init (random_parent.py). training_seconds set at launch; grad_accum set per learner topology. stream_views is OFF on Curio: DeviceRows page streaming deadlocked the 4-GPU allreduce on this host (trial a-stream-off vs control, 2026-10-31). coded_views on: actors send sparse row deltas, the learner decodes on the GPUs (66k vs 35k samples/s, trial t2). no_peace on and a capped game is a LOSS FOR BOTH seats (cap_score_reward 0, truncation_reward -1): with peace allowed and score-at-cap wins, self-play settled into peace until the cap (hero-1v1-scratch-v2, 2026-11-01); with capped games as 0-0 draws (v3 until update ~1400), the seat behind learned to turtle and 60-70% of games reached the cap as indecisive combat, so the cap now costs both seats a full loss. farsight (obs v3 + block_pool, 2026-11-01): learning_rate 2e-4 (was 3e-4) and kl_adapt_target 0.01: with the pooling bias the per-update KL ramped 0.010 -> 0.03 (clip fraction 0.18) twice at a fixed rate while bighero held 0.0085; the adaptive scale keeps it near bighero's level.
